title: Vino Verde Tarta
description: A tangy and flaky pastry filled with a refreshing vino verde and verde sauce, topped with a sweet tarta crumble.
instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, and salt.
Add cold butter and use a pastry blender or your fingers to work it into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Press dough into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a separate bowl, whisk together vino verde, verde, and egg.
Pour the filling into the tart shell.
Bake for 40-45 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
